articles.title: Cyber stalking
articles.source: Cyber Hayat PK safety library (general awareness)
articles.disclaimer: General safety information, not legal advice.
articles.what_it_means: Repeated unwanted digital contact, monitoring, or pursuit that causes fear.
articles.warning_signs: Unwanted contact, threats, leaked personal data, fake accounts, payment demands, sudden account lockouts.
articles.what_to_save: Usernames, URLs, timestamps, screenshots, payment details, original files, platform names.
articles.what_not_to_do: Do not send more money or intimate content. Do not delete evidence before copying it. Do not confront in ways that escalate physical risk.
articles.account_safety: Change passwords on a safe device, enable 2FA, review sessions, block the actor.
articles.reporting: Use in-app checklist, complaint generator, and official portals when online. Helplines are in the Helplines module.
articles.urgent: If you are in immediate physical danger, seek local emergency help or a trusted nearby person. This app cannot dispatch police.
